definitions.explanation: The part where string, rope, thread, or similar material has been tied together. Refers to the physical point of a knot.

examples.japanese: {結|むす}び{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{結|むす}び{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{固|かた}くて→固い：12090_katai⟧⟦{解|ほど}けない→解ける：18700_hodokeru⟧。
examples.english: The knot is too tight to untie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴紐|くつひも}→靴紐：16862_kutsuhimo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結|むす}び{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほどけ→ほどく：10504_hodoku⟧て、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{結|むす}び{直|なお}した。
examples.english: My shoelace knot kept coming undone, and I retied it many times.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧ (to tie) and ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (point, spot). Refers specifically to the physical point where something is knotted. Used for ropes, strings, threads, shoelaces, and similar materials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結|むす}び{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make a knot)
- {結|むす}び{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解|ほど}く (to untie a knot)
- {結|むす}び{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{緩|ゆる}い→緩い：00430_yurui⟧ (the knot is loose)
- {結|むす}び{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{固|かた}い→固い：12090_katai⟧ (the knot is tight)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧: to tie — the verb form, describes the action rather than the result
